description: REQ-008 (a full numbered MUST requirement with concrete Acceptance Criteria) remains entirely unimplemented and unexecuted. `queryLivePositions` does not exist anywhere in the repo (grepped the whole repo: zero matches outside of the spec docs and the iteration-1 review artifacts). No `launchctl bootout`/`bootstrap` restart of `ai.anicca.agent-economy-loop` has been performed as part of this implementation work: no `daemon.err.log`/`ledger.jsonl` shutdown record exists, no pre/post position-query evidence exists anywhere under `.vcsdd/features/config-delivery-verification/` (Glob for `evidence/**` returns zero files), and the plist itself still declares ANICCA_BRAIN=claude-p while the CURRENTLY RUNNING process (per the lead's own live-run evidence this session) still reports actual=proxy -- i.e. the real Bug 1 this whole feature exists to catch is still live in production, uncorrected. REQ-008's own Acceptance Criteria explicitly reject a lesser bar ('「plist を編集した」だけでは PASS と認めない'). This is not a documentation nicety; it is the concrete real-world fix this feature was chartered to verify actually landed, and it has not.
requiredFix: Implement `queryLivePositions` (registry-driven live-position query, e.g. wired to `hl.py account` per catalog-gate.mjs:128's existing queryFn pattern). Perform the actual `launchctl bootout`→`bootstrap` restart of `ai.anicca.agent-economy-loop` with the pre/post in-flight-wake and open-position safety checks REQ-008 mandates, and record the fresh evidence (shutdown ledger timestamp ordering, position-match query outputs, and a live detector run showing brainDrift=0 for this instance) under this feature's evidence directory before claiming REQ-008 satisfied.
